channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: $970 million Pacsun CEO says Gen Alpha and Gen Z are ‘greatly misunderstood’—so she made a board of 13- to 22-year-olds to give her advice
item.description: Brieane Olson, the CEO of Pacsun, says leaders will get a “get a much better return” if they listen to Gen Z and Gen Alpha instead of writing them off...

item.title: Nebraska rushed Medicaid work rules. Then a cancer patient was told he’d lost coverage
item.description: The nonpartisan Congressional Budget Office has estimated the policy will lead to 5.3 million more people being uninsured in the U.S. by 2034.

item.title: Nvidia had no succession plan when Jensen Huang quit. Former Fortune 500 CEOs call it ‘preposterous’
item.description: Jensen Huang had 60 direct reports and no clear heir. Ex-CEOs weigh in on how that could have been allowed to happen.

item.title: Meet the short seller that flagged Nvidia’s ‘significant China problem’ six months ago—including ‘uncomfortably close’ ties with Alice Huang
item.description: Culper Research shorted the largest company in the world in May—and six months later, it paid off.
